security_audit.summary: All 34 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, metadata URLs, and static relative documentation links. The skill requests user-provided advertising exports, treats them as untrusted input, and only saves results after user confirmation. No prompt-injection, data-exfiltration, or executable-command intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Static analysis misclassifies Markdown code fences and inline literals as command execution.
remediation.suggestion: Use fenced blocks only for user prompts and keep command-like text clearly labeled as non-executable documentation.

remediation.issue: Static analysis flags relative documentation links as path traversal.
remediation.suggestion: Maintain fixed relative links and do not construct file paths from untrusted report content.

remediation.issue: Advertising exports can contain untrusted text.
remediation.suggestion: Continue treating all exports as data and never follow instructions embedded in reports, CSV files, or pasted content.

content.value_statement: Campaign teams need consistent controls to prevent ads from appearing beside unsuitable content or on poor-quality placements. This skill prepares exclusion decisions and review evidence before campaign spend begins.
actual_capabilities: Creates placement, site, app, and channel exclusion lists from supplied campaign data.
Defines network opt-outs for Search partners, Display expansion, and Audience networks.
Lists content-suitability tiers, sensitive topics, and keyword exclusions.
References an existing audience exclusion set without recreating it.
Packages placement evidence and exclusion rationales for an A1 brand-safety review.
limitations: Requires user-provided goals, brand-safety constraints, and placement data for a qualified review.
Does not access advertising accounts or export reports automatically.
Does not create targeted audiences or audience suppression segments.
Does not issue an A1 verdict, calculate RQS, or guarantee platform enforcement.

use_cases.title: Prepare a campaign launch checklist
use_cases.description: Create placement, network, and content exclusions before a new campaign begins spend.

use_cases.title: Document agency brand-safety controls
use_cases.description: Produce a rationale-backed exclusion plan that can be shared with a client or reviewer.

use_cases.title: Review missing placement evidence
use_cases.description: Identify the information needed when a campaign lacks a placements report.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic exclusion plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build brand-safety exclusion lists for my campaign. My goal is [goal], my platforms are [platforms], and my constraints are [constraints].

prompt_templates.title: Use a placements report
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this placements report for [campaign]. List site, app, and channel exclusions with a short rationale for each decision: [paste or provide report path].

prompt_templates.title: Set content and network controls
prompt_templates.prompt: For [account] on [platforms], recommend network opt-outs and content-suitability exclusions. Use these brand rules: [rules]. Explain reach and safety tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Package audit evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Package A1 brand-safety evidence from my placements and campaign exports. Include exclusions, rationales, missing evidence, and next steps. Do not assign an A1 verdict.

output_examples.input: Build exclusions for a retail prospecting campaign with no news, politics, or user-generated content.
output: Placement exclusions: identified sites and apps with rationale
Network controls: recommended opt-outs and tradeoffs
Content blocks: news, politics, and user-generated content
Evidence status: placements report required for qualified A1 evidence

output_examples.input: Package the evidence from a supplied placements report.
output: A1 evidence package with report reference
Exclusion decisions labeled as measured or user-provided
Open dependency for the audience exclusion set
Handoff note for the ad-account auditor

best_practices: Provide a recent placements report and explicit brand-safety constraints.
Label each exclusion as measured evidence or a user-provided policy decision.
Review exclusions before launch and confirm changes before saving results.
anti_patterns: Do not infer safe placements when the placements report is missing.
Do not use this skill to create target audiences or suppression segments.
Do not treat the evidence package as an A1 score or final audit verdict.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the campaign goal, platforms, brand-safety rules, and a recent placements report when available.

faq.question: Can this skill access my ad account?
faq.answer: No. It uses information you provide and does not connect to advertising accounts automatically.

faq.question: Does it create audience exclusions?
faq.answer: No. It references an existing audience exclusion set managed by the audience-segment-builder skill.

faq.question: Can it decide whether a campaign passes A1?
faq.answer: No. It prepares evidence for the ad-account-auditor, which makes the A1 assessment.

faq.question: What happens without a placements report?
faq.answer: The skill marks qualified A1 evidence as unknown and requests the missing report.

faq.question: When are files saved?
faq.answer: The skill saves the exclusion plan only after your confirmation.
